blocks.text: Pursuant to § 15.2-2507, the Town of Keysville will hold a public hearing on Monday, July 13, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at the town office located at 120 J Street, Keysville VA 23947, to receive citizen input regarding the 2026-2027 Proposed Public Utility rates.
